description: Change details of one of the person's releases. Drafts can change everything and change at once; after publishing only description and price can change, and because that is public the change waits until the person confirms it in the browser (you get a confirmUrl to give them). Releases in review or scheduled are locked. Only the given fields change.

aiGenerated.description: AI labelling: no (made without AI), partly or yes (AI generated). Drafts only

genre.description: Main genre, one of: Electronic, House, Techno, Trance, Ambient, Downtempo, Synthwave, Pop, Rock, Indie, Jazz, Classical, Hip-Hop, Soundtrack, Experimental, RnB, Metal, Folk, Blues, Country, Reggae, Latin, World, DrumAndBass, Dubstep, Schlager, Kids, SpokenWord, Other. Drafts only

priceEur.description: Price of the whole release in EUR

releaseDate.description: Release date as YYYY-MM-DD, null removes it. Drafts only

secondaryGenre.description: Optional second genre, must differ from genre; empty string removes it

type.description: Release type: album, ep or single, drafts only

upc.description: UPC/EAN barcode (up to 32 characters), null removes it. Drafts only

name: studio_release_update
title: Edit one of my releases
